biography: Carlos Thomas hails from the bustling metropolis of Shanghai, China, a city where the roar of engines is usually drowned out by the cacophony of urban life. But for Carlos, the seed of racing was planted early. His grandfather, a former mechanic for a local touring car team, would regale him with tales of daring overtakes and nail-biting finishes. It wasn't long before Carlos traded the virtual world of racing games for the real deal, starting with go-karts at age 10. His raw talent was immediately apparent, but it was his relentless aggression and fearless approach that set him apart. Now, at 19, Carlos is an independent driver making waves in the regional Formula series. He's quickly gaining recognition for his audacious moves and unwavering determination, even if it occasionally lands him in hot water. He dreams of one day racing on the world stage, representing his country with pride and proving that Chinese drivers can compete with the best.
drivingStyle: Carlos Thomas is a driver who lives on the edge. His driving style is characterized by late braking, aggressive corner entries, and a constant search for any opportunity to gain a position. He's not afraid to make bold moves, often pushing the limits of grip and the patience of his rivals. While his aggressive approach can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also comes with the risk of mistakes and penalties. Tire management is an area he is actively working to improve, as his early aggression sometimes leads to late-race struggles. Under pressure, Carlos tends to double down on his aggression, either pulling off miraculous passes or succumbing to errors.

rivalries.name: Kenji 'The Silent Storm' Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A calculated and precise Japanese driver, Kenji often criticizes Carlos's aggressive moves as reckless and dangerous. Their contrasting styles frequently clash on track.

rivalries.name: Isabelle 'Ice Queen' Dubois
rivalries.reason: A French driver known for her cool demeanor, Isabelle has been on the receiving end of several of Carlos's aggressive overtakes, fueling a simmering rivalry.

rivalries.name: Ricardo 'The Matador' Alvarez
rivalries.reason: A flamboyant Spanish driver, Ricardo and Carlos share a similar aggressive style, leading to numerous on-track battles and occasional off-track disagreements.

quirks: Always wears a jade pendant gifted to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to traditional Chinese opera to calm his nerves before getting in the car.
Has a ritual of cleaning his racing gloves with a specific type of rice water believed to bring good luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe. It's about pushing the limits and taking chances. You miss 100% of the overtakes you don't try."
careerHighlight: Winning the Macau Grand Prix Formula Regional race after starting from P10, showcasing incredible overtaking skills on the challenging street circuit.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the championship-deciding race due to an overly ambitious overtaking attempt, costing him the series title.
